question: How many recall events (not individual product records) started for uncemented knee implants (MBH) from 2022-01-01 onwards?
answer:
**11 recall events** for MBH uncemented knee implants started on or after 2022-01-01. Together they cover **20 individual recall records**, because one event can include several product records.

Recent events in the results (only 10 of the 20 records were shown, so some events are not listed here):
- **Stryker, 2026-07-30:** the polyethylene raw material had been aged more than five years, which could raise oxidation and wear [Z-3203-2026]
- **Stryker, 2026-05-19:** Triathlon baseplates sizes 3 and 4 were packed in each other's labelled packaging (2 records) [Z-2461-2026], [Z-2462-2026]
- **Zimmer Biomet, 2026-05-11:** a posterior augment was found inside a distal augment package [Z-2578-2026]
- **MicroPort, 2024-10-29:** femoral implants were correctly marked but may have had the wrong packaging [Z-0699-2025]
- **Zimmer Biomet, 2024-03-13:** Vanguard tibial bearings may have been damaged during manufacturing [Z-1607-2024]
- **DePuy Synthes (J&J), 2024-03-12:** product was labelled incorrectly [Z-1456-2024]
- **Stryker, 2024-02-06:** the inner and outer sterile blisters may have been breached (3 of the records shown) [Z-1259-2024], [Z-1260-2024], [Z-1261-2024]

Things to keep in mind:
- The recall data covers all years, while the adverse-event reports only run from 2022 to 2024. So the count includes recalls that started in 2026, after the report data ends.
- Most of these recalls are about packaging, labelling or manufacturing processes. They don't show how often devices fail in patients.
